Initech — Monthly Performance Report, September 2026

Prepared by Acme Digital for Initech Software · Reporting period: September 1–30, 2026 · Account lead: Andrés Villalobos · Delivered October 7, 2026 · All amounts in USD.

Summary

September 2026 was Initech's strongest month of the year for pipeline. Paid campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads generated 540 leads, 218 MQLs and 58 SQLs, adding $1,283,400 in new pipeline. Spend was $36,150, for a blended cost per lead of $66.94.

The AP Automation ROI Calculator was the highest-converting asset of the month, and the Spanish replay of the August Mexico webinar kept producing leads for the Mexico City team.

Next Steps

  • A/B test a shorter ROI Calculator landing page (3 fields instead of 6) starting October 13.
  • Pause Google Display prospecting from October 1 and move its $2,000 monthly budget to Google Search.
  • Send the Q3 business review deck to Derek Lindqvist by October 16.
